swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): Marking the water level on a glass tumbler helps investigate the source of outside droplets. Reason (R): If the water level does not drop while droplets appear outside, the droplets cannot have come from water seeping out of the tumbler. Choose the correct option.

add.q: Assertion (A): Water droplets forming on the outside of a glass tumbler of ice-cold water must have seeped out through the glass from inside. Reason (R): Water droplets form on the outside of a glass tumbler of ice-cold water because water vapour in the air condenses on the cold surface. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is false, R is true
o: A is false, R is true
A is true, R is false
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A

swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): Ice placed in a freezer will not freeze any further. Reason (R): Freezing is the conversion of a liquid into a solid, and ice is already solid. Choose the correct option.

add.q: Assertion (A): Ice placed in a freezer will not freeze any further. Reason (R): This is because freezing is the conversion of a solid into its liquid state, and ice is already a liquid. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is true, R is false
o: A is true, R is false
A is false, R is true
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
